bills.title: Combatting Antisemitism, Hate and Extremism (Criminal and Migration Laws) Bill 2026

name: The majority voted against [two identical amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2026-01-20.130.1) introduced by the Nationals and by Pauline Hanson's One Nation, which means they were unsuccessful. There was one rebellion, with Liberal Senator [Alex Antic](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/sa/alex_antic) (SA) voting Yes against the rest of the Liberal Party, who voted No. ### Amendment text > *Omit all words after "That", substitute "the bill be referred to the Legal and Constitutional Affairs Legislation Committee for inquiry and report by 2 March 2026".*
